senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. נְהֵי I) to be agitated; to make a noise.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 32a:9">Ber. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>אין ארי נוֹהֵם וכ׳</he> the lion does not get excited over a heap of straw but over a heap of flesh, i.e. plenty produces haughtiness.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 277:1">Yalk. Jer. 277</cite> (play on <he>בן הֹנֹםֹ</he>, <cite ref="Jeremiah 19:2">Jer. XIX, 2</cite>) <he>שקולו של תינוק נ̇ו̇הֵ֗ם̇ וכ׳</he> for the voice of the child shrieked under the fire; a. fr.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3a">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>מְנַהֶמֶת כיונה</he> cooing (in mourning) like a dove.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="N00265"><he>נְהִימָה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 106:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. CVI, 9</cite> <he>מְנַהֵם עליהם כנהמת ים</he> (adapted fr.
<cite ref="Isaiah 5:30">Is. V, 30</cite>) he roared over them &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 864:5">Yalk. Ps. 864</cite> <he>ויִנְהםֹ</he>.
